images.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a spectacular original vertical 2:3 mixed-media creator campaign poster, full bleed final artwork for an independent concept portfolio, intended to demonstrate TikTok-style image effect and visual creativity capability without any TikTok branding. Concept CITY REMIX: a real young East Asian adult wearing an oversized cobalt blue windbreaker, cropped waist-up in a dynamic candid walking gesture, their silhouette playfully breaking through a colossal torn-magazine circular portal. The city behind transitions between precise architectural black-and-white photography, peach halftone comics and radiant citrus flat color. The portal is assembled from tactile editorial paper, tiny graphic red arrows, sticker shapes and photographic slices, not generic neon technology. Very bold masterful magazine typography integrated as geometric visual structure. Strong physical light, convincing hands and face, natural human expression, sophisticated large-scale paper collage, controlled grain. Palette butter yellow, cobalt, tomato red, black and white. Plenty of disciplined space around text. Text EXACTLY: top small "CITY REMIX / 01"; enormous English headline broken two lines "MAKE" "YOUR SCENE"; smaller Chinese "把日常，切换成主场"; footer tiny "INDEPENDENT CONCEPT". No other text or logos. Premium international youth culture direction, striking silhouette, absolutely no app UI mockup, no rounded cards, no montage of multiple posters.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create an exceptional Chinese AIGC creator challenge campaign KV, landscape 16:9. Original independent creative concept: "把城市折进一张纸". A single enormous warm ivory sheet of paper unfurls over a cobalt blue ground and folds into a precise miniature contemporary Chinese city with a bridge, apartment alleys, street trees, stairs and little shop façades, every building crafted from the SAME continuous paper; extraordinary origami architectural photography. One vivid vermilion folded paper bird flying above is the singular brand symbol. Sunlit paper edges, deep ultramarine shadows, restrained tactile material, subtle realistic fiber texture. Understated contemporary cultural campaign, not childish craft, no ornate traditional tourist clichés. Camera elevated oblique close view, urban paper sculpture dominates right 60%, text on left 40% in huge ivory bold modern Chinese typography with perfect optical spacing. Exact text main three short lines "把城市" / "折进" / "一张纸"; small top "PAPER CITY / CREATOR CHALLENGE"; subhead "一座城市，一种你的折法。"; footer "INDEPENDENT CONCEPT". Rich spatial hierarchy, visually brilliant minimalist exhibition poster. Full bleed final artwork, no mockup, no frame, no panels.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create one premium landscape 16:9 brand launch KV for an original fictional workplace collaboration product called SYNC 同频, not an official Feishu advertisement. Creative metaphor: many translucent azure-blue glass strips, like fragmented messages, beautifully converge into ONE remarkably elegant clear organized luminous ribbon track traveling through a white architectural space. A tiny warm orange sphere at the convergence is the human decision point. Restrained clean 3D material rendering, optical glass caustics, matte white walls, daylight, soft blue translucent shadows; sophisticated real B2B brand direction. Composition dynamic flowing diagonal that leaves strong clean white typography area at left; use huge precise dark navy modern Chinese sans. Text EXACTLY: top-left "SYNC / 同频"; main on two lines "少一层切换" / "多一步向前"; below "让信息、决定与行动，在同一条线上。"; small bottom "COLLABORATION, IN FLOW."; tiny bottom-right "INDEPENDENT CONCEPT". Professional restrained art direction with large negative space. No generic AI robots, no tech wireframes, no fake software screenshots, no other logos or words. Full bleed flat finished graphic, no mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create an extraordinary character development presentation sheet, landscape 16:9, for an original cinematic short called LANTERN COURIER. Hero: a compact humble delivery automaton with a spherical warm porcelain head, exactly two small black circular eyes, an arched dark-teal metal weather hood, short dark-teal articulated body, mitten-shaped hands, two boot-like feet, a red cloth crossbody satchel and one warm amber lantern carried in its left hand. Memorable elegant silhouette, realistically worn enamel, brass joints, subtle scuffs; kind and industrious, not a copy of any famous robot. Present FOUR consistent full-body orthographic views (front, left profile, back, three-quarter) aligned at identical scale on an unadorned warm ivory studio backdrop, thin tasteful baseline, spacious precise industrial-design layout, actual recognizable back of satchel strap and anatomy in reverse views. High-end film concept sculpt rendering with consistent features, avoid cute toy packaging. Small top-left text "LANTERN COURIER"; small top-right "CHARACTER STUDY / 01"; bottom labels "FRONT", "SIDE", "BACK", "3/4" directly under each respective view, no other words. One sheet, no drop-shadow card layouts, no frames.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Cinematic editorial photograph of a tiny contemporary Chinese neighborhood fruit shop immediately after rain at blue hour, landscape 16:9. No people. A dark teal painted storefront with folded cream awning; amber light from within; foreground crates of red tomatoes, green pears and orange citrus arranged with naturally imperfect rhythms; wet terrazzo pavement with reflections and a yellow bicycle wheel at the far edge. Handwritten shop labels exist only as blurred tiny textures, no readable signs or brand logo. Camera at human eye level, 50mm lens, balanced central architectural composition, medium depth of field, refined physically truthful wet surfaces, delicate film grain, warm-cool color harmony, tactile detail, quiet emotional realism, richly controlled luminance with no blown neon. This is the neutral source frame for a controlled AIGC aesthetics study. No text overlay, no collage, no border, no invented fantasy props.

Use case: identity-preserve. Image 1 is the locked character reference for LANTERN COURIER. Create a single exquisite cinematic keyframe 16:9 landscape of this EXACT little dark teal enamel courier automaton, porcelain sphere face, exactly two black eyes, arched hood, brass joints, red crossbody satchel, one amber lantern held in its LEFT hand. Full body occupies the lower right third of a rain-washed narrow Chinese urban alley at blue hour. The robot is standing beside a low wooden shop doorway, softly lifting its lantern toward the unlit shop window. Eye-level 50mm composition, believable scale, textured brick, puddle reflections, steam in the far background, strong warm amber / cold blue cinematography. Gentle emotion of one small light making a home feel inhabited. Keep character face, proportions, satchel shape and signature hood identical to reference. Do not add other characters, limbs, neon signs, text, logos or watermarks. NOT a contact sheet, a single full-bleed cinematic scene with depth and realism, elegant film production art.

Use case: identity-preserve. Image 1 is the locked character bible reference. Make a clean 2x2 controlled visual test sheet, landscape16:9, each quadrant showing the SAME exact full-body courier automaton in same upright three-quarter pose, same scale, same red crossbody satchel and single left-hand amber lantern, porcelain face with two black eyes, dark teal metal hood, brass joints, short legs, no mouth. Four test contexts only: upper left soft diffuse daylight on ivory backdrop; upper right hard golden backlight with readable rim silhouette; bottom left rainy blue-hour wet surfaces with retained teal body/amber lantern; bottom right dark low-key scene lit mostly by its lantern, face and silhouette still readable. Thin ivory gutters. Label each quadrant in precise tiny sans uppercase at lower left respectively "01 / DAY", "02 / BACKLIGHT", "03 / RAIN", "04 / LOW LIGHT". No other text. This is an honest visual consistency stress test contact sheet, cinematic material realism and excellent professional film asset-development art.
